_: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The trust gate (docs/trust-gate.md) is a DENYLIST: it may only ever blank a field path that is named here, so a generator bug fails safe (a record the generator never reaches keeps everything) instead of emptying the app. Seeded once, by hand, from the non-underscore field lists of OUR_KINDS (scripts/wg-diff.mjs:396-582) plus the nested container paths ourKindsOf walks (scripts/wg-diff.mjs:1216-1330), MINUS everything docs/trust-gate.md section 1 protects, MINUS OUR_KINDS._noCounterpart (scripts/wg-diff.mjs:582). Every path below was confirmed to occur on at least one record of the 8 WG-paired buckets in public/core.json on 2026-09-10; the count in each `why` is that measurement. Entries are PATHS, not bare field names, so a nested grant can be emptied without touching the option row that asks the question. `kinds` is the full kind list fieldToKinds gives the path: the path stays ON when ANY one of those kinds is in the record's theirKinds (docs/trust-gate-decisions.md decision 1 — ANY, not EVERY, because `innateSpells` answers spellcasting+spell and a WG row that encodes only `spell` HAS encoded the innate spell; the aeon stones are the case).
_reseeded: 2026-09-11, docs/trust-gate-decisions.md decision 5 ("after the desk-fix batch lands, trust-fields.json is re-seeded and the guard re-run"). Re-measured by the SAME rule as the original seed — every OUR_KINDS leaf x every container ourKindsOf walks, occurring on at least one record of the 8 paired buckets, minus the protected and _excluded sets. Result: 159 paths are carried now, 137 were already listed, ONE was new (`choice.options[].grant.whileActive`, carried by 4 class features — the four barbarian instincts — as 68 whileActive blocks; the sibling leaf entry's "68 class features" was a value count mislabelled as a record count and is corrected in the same pass), and NO listed path has stopped occurring. The three paths decision 5 names as desk-fix creations — `choice.options[].grant.grantsFeats`, `enhancement.grant.resistances`, `effectChoices[].options[].grant.grantedStrikes` — occurred on NO record at that measurement, so they stayed what decision 5 allows them to be: `pending` approvals, not universe paths. ⚠ RE-MEASURED AGAIN 2026-09-11 by the same rule, after the batch-037 RESIDUAL lanes (molten-wit / reborn-soul / flexible-spellcaster) were applied to the overlay: `choice.options[].grant.grantsFeats` now occurs (feats/molten-wit, the desk #12 three-branch row) and is therefore LISTED below — 139 paths occurring, 138 already listed, ONE new, and again NO listed path has stopped occurring. The other two creations still occur nowhere. `restrictedSkillIncreaseLevels` (the desk #85 carrier on backgrounds/reborn-soul) is NOT added and is not an omission: it appears in no OUR_KINDS field list, so it is outside fieldToKinds and the denylist can never reach it. `grantsItems[].whenChoice` (1 feat) and `resonant.spellNotes` (3 items) are carried now and are recorded under `_excluded` rather than added: the first has no leaf fieldToKinds names, the second is prose.

_excluded._: Paths that a naive seed from OUR_KINDS would have produced and that are DELIBERATELY not in the universe. Recorded here rather than dropped silently, because a future reader will otherwise re-add them.

zero-occurrence._: In fieldToKinds, but no record in the 8 paired buckets carries them (measured 2026-09-10). Listing a path that occurs nowhere would make the section-5 completeness guard green on a lie.

cost-or-limit._: Section 1: only a BENEFIT goes dark. Turning one of these off hands the player a character STRONGER than print.
cost-or-limit.passiveEffects.speedPenalty: the same cost one level down (2 items)
cost-or-limit.weaknesses: a weakness the record imposes on itself (7 records)
cost-or-limit.dedicationGate: 'you cannot select another dedication feat until…' (17 feats)
cost-or-limit.choiceOptionLimits: a record that NARROWS another record's pick (17 records)

prose._: Section 1: prose is not a mechanic. wg-diff already filters `note` out of `missing` (scripts/wg-diff.mjs:3369).
prose.resonant.spellNotes: the same prose one level down, on the aeon stone's slotted-in-a-wayfinder block (3 items). Recorded at the 2026-09-11 re-seed: `resonant` is a field of the 2026-09-11 item-held-spells rule, and this is the one path under it that the rule must NOT bring back, because prose was never stripped in the first place

chassis._: Section 1: item/weapon/ancestry chassis is never touched. Each of these was checked against public/core.json and occurs ONLY as a printed stat-block line, never as a granted benefit.
chassis.acBonus: armour's own AC (398 items, e.g. hellknight-plate=6) — named in section 1
chassis.hp: a shield's Hit Points (167 items, e.g. arrow-catching-shield=60) and an ancestry's HP (50) — the same family as `hardness`, which section 1 names; it occurs in no other bucket, so listing it could only ever damage a shield
chassis.attackItemBonus: a bomb grade's own printed attack bonus (122 items, e.g. sulfur-bomb-major=3) — the offensive twin of `acBonus`; JUDGEMENT CALL, flagged to the owner
chassis.vision: an ancestry's vision (50 ancestries) — named in section 1

builder-structure._: Section 1: never strip builder structure. Inside a choice/effectChoices option the gate empties the option's `grant`, which is why the nested `…options[].grant.*` paths ARE in the universe.
builder-structure.choiceResistance: a picker whose ANSWER is the resistance, shaped {options,halfLevel} with no separable `grant` sub-path (3 records: heritages/deep-fetchling, heritages/elementheart-kobold, backgrounds/energy-scarred). Blanking it would delete the control section 1 requires to stay. Measured: both heritages carry defense+choice in theirKinds today, so this exclusion changes nothing in the current ledger.

package._: A field whose value bundles a benefit AND a cost cannot be half-blanked without leaving the player worse than either printed option.
package.alternateAttributes: a heritage's whole attribute package — boosts AND flaws together (2 records: heritages/mightyfall-kobold, backgrounds/song-of-the-deep). Sub-paths alternateAttributes.abilityBoosts / .abilityFlaws are excluded with it; alternateAttributes.hp is read by ourKindsOf but occurs on no record. Measured: mightyfall-kobold carries `attribute` in theirKinds today, so this exclusion changes nothing in the current ledger.

no-counterpart._: OUR_KINDS._noCounterpart (scripts/wg-diff.mjs:582): ours with no operation on their side at all, so no WG kind can ever credit them and a gate keyed to WG kinds would blank every one. `degreeShifts` is the only one of the eight that ALSO appears in a real kind list (`conditional`), so it is the only one fieldToKinds knows — a section-5 completeness guard must therefore read, in docs/trust-gate-decisions.md decision 4's wording, 'every path fieldToKinds knows, EXCEPT OUR_KINDS._noCounterpart, is in trust-fields.json (as a path or under `_excluded`)'. `degreeShifts` is the case that made the wording matter: a guard written as 'every fieldToKinds path is a path' would go red on it forever, and a guard that ignored `_excluded` would go green on a path silently dropped.

leaf-not-in-fieldToKinds._: Nested paths that occur in core.json but whose leaf no OUR_KINDS list names, so no WG kind maps to them and the per-path rule has nothing to ask. Not in the universe; recorded so the next reader does not think they were missed.
